## The Headline

ESPN: **"Cade Cunningham's historic night puts Pistons past Wizards in 2OT thriller"**

That's the kind of line that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score. Look, 52 points and 11 assists with zero turnovers is objectively spectacular—no argument there. But let's pump the brakes on the "historic night" framing for just a second. This happened against the Wizards, in double overtime, in a game that needed 58 minutes to resolve itself because neither team could get stops. I'm not saying Cade didn't ball out—he absolutely did—but "historic" is the kind of word that ESPN slaps on every 50-point game these days, and it's starting to lose all meaning. We're filing this one under "impressive individual performance that may or may not tell us anything about where Detroit is actually headed this season." Check back with me in March.
